hero.title: YouTube Clone
hero.subtitle: A home page, built by hand.
hero.tagline: A static YouTube home layout from February 21, 2023. Header, sidebar, search bar, and a grid of video cards. No framework and no video player.
hero.impact: The layout below is that page. Icon paths point at the images/ and SVG/ folders, and the menu button has an image so the sidebar can be toggled.

embed.label: Look through it
embed.title: Header, sidebar, and the video grid.
embed.body: Click the menu to hide the sidebar. The search box and the video titles are static. Thumbnails are empty black boxes, the same as the original file.

problems.d: The header, sidebar, and video grid had to be plain HTML and CSS, with one click of JavaScript.
The side list takes a fixed column. The menu has to hide it, and a narrow screen should start with it closed.
Fifteen video cards need to wrap as the page gets narrower, without a fixed column count.
The markup asks for images/ and SVG/. Those files have to sit in those folders or the header and sidebar render empty.

layers.title: One flex row
layers.desc: Menu, logo, search field, mic, create, notifications, and a profile photo.

layers.title: Stacked links
layers.desc: Home, library, subscriptions, and settings. On a screen under 550px the sidebar starts hidden.

layers.title: Auto-fit cards
layers.desc: Fifteen cards use CSS grid with a 270px minimum, so the row count follows the width.

layers.title: One class
layers.desc: The menu adds or removes hide on the sidebar. Search and the cards do not run any script.
